u0: Initial/no-obligation state: the exit has not been reached successfully and there is no unsatisfied siren-switch obligation. Head for the exit; if the siren starts ringing before the switch has been toggled, the machine will move into an active switch obligation state. Reaching the exit while the siren is silent completes the task.
u1: Active siren-switch obligation: the siren has rung and the switch has not yet been toggled in response. Next objective: go to the wall switch and toggle it. Reaching the exit before toggling does not satisfy this state.
u2: Siren-switch obligation satisfied: the switch has been toggled after the siren rang, so no further switch action is required even if the siren rings again. Next objective: go to the exit; arriving completes the task.
u3: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached with either no unresolved siren obligation or the required switch toggle already performed. No further objective remains.
